title: Second cohomology of a generic extension on an affine curve
statement:
Let $C/k$ be a smooth integral affine
connected curve over algebraically closed $k$
and $\eta:\operatorname{Spec}k(C)\to C$ its
generic point.
For every torsion etale sheaf
$M$ on $\operatorname{Spec}k(C)$, one has
$H^2(C,\eta_*M)=0$, with
etale cohomology.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sc-generic-torsion-finite-stalk-colimit] to obtain a filtered presentation of $M$ by torsion finite-stalk sheaves and the corresponding colimit cocone in second cohomology after generic direct image.

For every diagram object, apply [lem-sc-affine-generic-finite-second]. Supply its finite-extension-model input using [lem-sc-finite-extension-affine-model] and its constant-sheaf input using [lem-sc-affine-constant-second]. Thus every object of the cohomology diagram is zero.
A colimit of zero objects is zero. In Lean, apply IsColimit.isZero_pt to the mapped cocone and Functor.isZero to its objectwise vanishing, then AddCommGrpCat.subsingleton_of_isZero.

proof_origin.place: Proof, paragraphs 1--4; H1: finite-stalk and colimit steps are separate obligations, combined by the proved zero-colimit argument.
